verdict.rationale: Gram documents an in-dashboard agent harness ("Connect") that lets developers pick a server, authenticate, chat with a model that calls tools, and inspect logs — before connecting a real client, matching the browser-based inspector/playground story directly. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and no detail on how granular per-tool invocation (vs. full chat) works in the playground.
